If the backend omits attentionCount, the Issues column always shows 0. Change the table to (r.commentsNeedingAttention || []).length to match InlineAnalysis, or confirm the backend populates both fields.

Tab emoji vs screenshot SVG icons — The screenshot's tabs render SVG icons (Lucide-style), not emoji. The plan specified emoji strings; the coder followed the plan. If the tab appearance needs to match the screenshot exactly, swap the emoji strings for Lucide icon components (FileText, Users, BarChart2) in the tab data array.

All Status dropdown missing appearance-none pr-8 — The plan required these classes to suppress the native browser dropdown indicator and match the screenshot's clean chevron. They are absent from the <select> in the implementation. Add appearance-none pr-8 to the select className.
